decisions.rationale: public knowledge snippets do not provide sufficient evidence to establish a relation between Type B lactic acidosis secondary to diffuse large B-cell lymphoma and mesenteric lymphoma

option_relations.rationale: Small bowel ischemia due to mesenteric lymphoma is a specific instance of mesenteric lymphoma
Mesenteric lymphoma with bowel ischemia is essentially the same as mesenteric lymphoma
Type B lactic acidosis secondary to diffuse large B-cell lymphoma is related to mesenteric lymphoma, but with additional specifics
Non-Hodgkin lymphoma is a broader category that includes mesenteric lymphoma
